mostWorthwhile.text: Following stored glycogen through release into the blood was most worthwhile. The between-meal explanation gave the sequence a clear purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the portal vessel was straightforward but added no explanation, making it feel more like assembly than a discovery.

surprise.text: The explanation that the liver releases glucose between meals clarified why storing glycogen matters.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although connecting the portal vessel after following portal nutrients to the liver made the order feel a little odd.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it developed these connections further; this chapter's clear biology was useful, but several steps felt predictable.
